title: Check if One String Swap Can Make Strings Equal
summary: Given two strings of equal length, determine if it is possible to make both strings identical by performing at most one swap of characters in one of the strings.
statement: Given two strings of equal length, determine if it is possible to make both strings identical by performing at most one swap of characters in one of the strings.
constraints: The strings have equal length and contain lowercase English letters.
Return whether zero or one swap of two positions in exactly one string can make the strings equal.
hints: One swap changes either zero or exactly two mismatching positions.
Collect the aligned character pairs that differ.
Accept no mismatches, or exactly two pairs that are reverses of each other.
Reverse mismatch pairs are precisely the two characters exchanged by one swap; every other mismatch count or pairing is impossible.
editorial: Reverse mismatch pairs are precisely the two characters exchanged by one swap; every other mismatch count or pairing is impossible.

tests.explanation: The two mismatches cross-match, so swapping the first and last characters makes the strings equal.
There are more than two mismatches, so one swap cannot repair them.
